## Standalone acceptance runners

These files intentionally expose main() instead of pytest test functions. CI invokes
them explicitly because they need a live KiCad process, native IPC server, virtual X11
display, or the KiCad-managed plugin environment. The collection guard allows only
these registered exceptions to collect zero pytest cases.

| Runner | Purpose | Invocation/context |
| --- | --- | --- |
| tests/test_eeschema_gui.py | Launches a real Eeschema window, creates a functional block, opens the stored implementation in the native editor, saves it, and verifies the editor workflow. | Run in the virtual display with the configured KiCad executable. |
| tests/test_instance_configuration_gui.py | Drives the production instance-configuration dialog with real Tk widgets; selects a profile and verifies the variant, typed parameter, layout, and single IPC commit. | Run in the virtual display; also invoked by plugin registration and visual capture. |
| tests/test_ipc_headless.py | Exercises the real KiCad schematic IPC server without a GUI, including placement, instance configuration, library registration, and local-copy actions. | Run against the pinned kicad-python wheel and KiCad nightly IPC server. |
| tests/test_library_picker_gui.py | Uses X11 keyboard events against the real searchable block picker and checks that the facade preview is rendered by KiCad rather than approximated. | Run in the virtual display; also invoked inside KiCad's managed plugin environment. |
| tests/test_pcb_ipc.py | Exercises native PCB IPC primitives and verifies the board-item operations used by the plugin against a live KiCad PCB Editor IPC server. | Run with the pinned KiCad Python IPC binding and a live PCB Editor server. |
| tests/test_pcb_layout.py | Runs the PCB block-layout import and merge acceptance path against real board files, checking the generated output with KiCad's own command-line parser. | Run with KiCad CLI and the integration dependencies available. |
| tests/test_plugin_registration.py | Installs the package into KiCad's managed plugin directory, launches Eeschema, verifies discovery and environment readiness, and exercises the installed task hub, picker, and instance-configuration entry points. | Run in the virtual display with KiCad nightly; this is the managed-environment gate. |

## Additional CI validation runners

These are test-support/acceptance tools but are not named test_*.py, so pytest does
not collect them as modules.

| Runner | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| tests/capture_visual_docs.py | Captures real KiCad/Tk production UI states and native-rendered schematic evidence, then writes the visual bundle and SHA-256 provenance manifest consumed by CI. |
| tests/create_block_ipc_integration.py | Drives the registered Create Block action against live KiCad schematic IPC; verifies typed SheetSymbol and active-sheet behavior, extracted pins, project-library registration, rollback on registration failure, and preservation of source project sheets. |
| tests/validate_kicad_cli.py | Generates the STUSB4500 reference block, exports its KiCad netlist/BOM/ERC artifacts, and validates the generated files with KiCad CLI. |
